newsitem.title: DENMARK: Topdanmark and Eureko reduce crossholding.
newsitem.headline: Topdanmark and Eureko reduce crossholding.

text.p: Danish insurer Topdanmark and Dutch-based Eureko BV have agreed to reduce their crossholdings, statements from both firms said on Tuesday.

Eureko's share in Topdanmark was to fall to 20 percent from 29.98 percent, with Danish and foreign institutional investors taking up 4.8 percent of the paper and the remaining five percent offered to Eureko's partners, with an option to sell to Topdanmark.
Topdanmark said it was cutting its stake in Eureko to about 7.3 percent -- depending on the share price on the day of the transaction -- from 12.3 percent
Topdanmark said it asked for the reduction in order to reduce its financial exposure. Its reduced Eureko stake will represent around 14 percent of its own capital, compared to 23 percent previously.
"Topdanmark believes that the agreement will not effect the sound commericial cooperation between Topdanmark and the other Eureko partners," the statement said.
